name: Task List
implementation_notes: Used vi.hoisted() in BE tests to resolve ESM vi.mock hoisting issues
BE tests avoid real DB connections by mocking src/models/db.js and src/models/task.js
Route handler tests extract Express router middleware via router.stack inspection
FE tests use @vue/test-utils mount in jsdom; api() is mocked via vi.mock
Bug fix — 'Add Task' button always visible: moved from empty-state to controls row (brand-styled button)
Bug fix — delete without confirmation: renamed confirmDelete() to deleteTask(), removed confirm() guard
Test update — added tests for Add Task visibility (empty + data state) and delete without confirmation

known_issues.description: Vitest config uses jsdom as global environment for both BE and FE tests; ideal setup would separate node for BE and jsdom for FE
